description: Priced both plates at sixpence, and made the king pay sooner than a carter's habit.
name: Agnes Tipping

description: Ralph Raye reported a fair restless yard and the road to Shoreditch, and stopped before a figure.
name: William Blackwage, Ralph Raye, Richard Hoope

description: Stayed in the king long enough to make the tapster kneel, then agreed to come out of him.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Named the nun and the bear-baiting, and was answered with a wedding.
name: Will Kemp

description: Chose the eggs, chose the wedding, and would not hear a Rose receipt.
name: William Shakespeare
